expectations.evidence: Verified: FormatComments declared at table.go:191 and :238 (go build fails); tasksCmd uses MaximumNArgs(1) and local (non-persistent) -o flag; getTask orchestrates multiple calls in commands; client doRequest sends nil body and only Get exists; Task.List is ListInfo (id/name only); isCustomTaskID duplicated in tasks.go:67 and comments.go:17; warnings to os.Stderr at tasks.go:120,128; Execute prints Error: and exits 1; no tests for api/commands. citations.json: 31/31 valid.

Mirrors command-orchestrates/thin-API layering, getAPIClient/getConfig wiring, fmt.Errorf wrap with %w, stderr warnings, output.GetFormatter. Deviations (io.Writer instead of os.Stdout, own -o var, addCustomTaskIDParams refactor, SetBaseURL) are named with reasons.

Approach B (API client owns flow, InvalidStatusError) and C (update first, explain on failure) are structurally different and rejected with concrete reasons (business rules in API layer; depends on unverified ClickUp error text).

All four preferences honoured: exact case-insensitive match via EqualFold, no prefix (test 'in' vs 'in progress'); already-set prints notice, no PUT, exit 0 (also with -o json after user feedback); OrderedStatuses sorts by Orderindex; no confirmation prompt. Transcript answers (join args, trim, one line + -o json, A) are reflected.

Matching, multi-word and output were asked up front; user volunteered already-set, board order, no-prompt. Remaining design decisions (home list, send list's spelling, closed statuses, -o fallback, debug body) listed as explicit numbered assumptions.

Success, invalid status, already-set (text and json), blank status, arg count, config, GetTask/GetList/Update API failures all designed with user-visible output and exit codes; tests and E2E listed. Minor gap: list returning zero statuses not discussed.

Signatures of changeTaskStatus, printStatusChange, printStatusUnchanged, invalidStatusError, FindStatus, Matches, OrderedStatuses, GetList, UpdateTaskStatus agree across html and md after the late out/errOut revision (grep verified).

Fits existing types: models.Status with Orderindex, Task.List.ID, Client.GetTask(taskID, teamID), doRequest extension with optional payload keeps Get callers intact, cobra child under tasksCmd. Implementable without redesign.
Both approaches page and plan state main does not compile: DetailFormatter.FormatComments declared twice at table.go:191 and :238, with Commit 0 to delete the older copy.

suggestions.reason: Does not check for edge cases like a list with no/inherited statuses or a task whose home list differs from the list the user means; plan assumes home list explicitly but nothing probes it.
